drop.text: Her nose is sometimes described as being of iron.
drop.reason: The model draws the iron nose as a metal cap (bake-off and 2c grid).

drop.text: As she lies in her hut she often stretches across from one corner to the other, and her nose goes right through the ceiling.
drop.reason: A posture in a setting, not an appearance a single figure plate can show.

visual.text: A frightening, witch-like old hag with an enormous, very long hooked nose that reaches down past her chin, a jutting pointed chin, sunken cheeks and glaring, malicious deep-set eyes. A sly, menacing grin shows crooked teeth. Long, thin, wild, unkempt hair falls down past her shoulders. She is gaunt and wiry but fully fleshed; her arms and hands are thin and wrinkled, with knobbly knuckles and long fingers ending in sharp nails. She wears ragged peasant clothes and leans on a gnarled wooden staff. Full figure.
visual.negative_extra: skeleton, bare bones, skull, metal, kindly expression, sad expression
visual.note: Second redo: Ben wants her scarier and more witch-like, with a bigger nose.

visual.text: A three-headed dragon standing on four powerful clawed legs, with two large wings spread from its back and a long, thick dragon tail. Each of its three heads rises on its own long neck, ferocious, with open jaws and sharp teeth; one head breathes a stream of fire. Scaled body. Full figure.
visual.note: Ben: the common image is a three-headed, four-legged, winged dragon, not the sourced winged serpent.

visual.text: An uncanny old spirit of the forest in the shape of a gaunt, wild old man, dressed in moss, bark, dead leaves and forest debris. One of his arms is gnarled and knotted like a tree branch, half arm and half wood. From his head grow branching antlers of gnarled tree branches, many-pointed like a stag's antlers but made of wood and twigs. He has a long, tangled beard, a long drooping moustache and dishevelled hair hanging down. His eyes are wild, staring and cold, and his expression is unfriendly and menacing: a wandering creature of the woods that might eat a lost traveller. His legs are reverse-jointed, bending backward at the knee like the hind legs of a beast, and end in gnarled, clawed feet. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.note: Ben, round 3: too friendly; show the whole body and reverse-jointed legs; keep the tree-like arm.
visual.negative_extra: kindly expression, smiling, jolly old man, close-up

visual.text: The gruesome, half-rotted corpse of a young village woman. Grey, rotting skin and flesh still cling to her face and body, torn open in places to show the bone beneath; her arms are thin and withered but still fleshed. She wears a rotted, tattered peasant festival dress, as if she died at a midsummer festival, and a small wreath of field flowers sits on her matted hair. Her lower jaw has been torn off and dangles by a thin strip of skin down against her collarbone, leaving only her upper teeth above a gaping throat, from which a very long, grotesque tongue hangs down, tapering to a point. Her eyes are blank white orbs in deep black sockets. She holds a curved sickle. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.note: Ben, round 3: seed 22 closest; a half-rotted corpse, not a full skeleton; the jaw gone or hanging by a thread at the collarbone.

visual.text: A tiny, strange, mischievous little old man, no taller than the wooden bucket of water that stands beside him on the wooden floor of a bathhouse; he and the bucket are almost the same size. He is scrawny and sinewy, with wild white hair, a long white beard and moustache, a sly impish grin and glinting eyes. He clutches a bundle of leafy birch twigs, a bath whisk. The bathhouse bench and log walls tower over him, showing how small he is. He is the only figure in the picture. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.negative_extra: other people, bather, victim, demon, horns, bathtub
visual.note: Ben, round 3: looked like a man in a bathtub; make him tiny, strange and mischievous, about the size of the bucket.

visual.text: A gaunt, malnourished, hairless monster, humanoid but monstrous. Thin skin is stretched tight over a starved, fleshed body: its belly is sucked in hollow beneath the rib cage, and its limbs are skinny and sinewy. Its legs are digitigrade and reverse-jointed, like a dog's hind legs: it stands on its toes, and the knee bends backward. Its forearms are very long and end in long, sharp claws. Its face is narrow and pointed, with long pointed ears and a vicious mouth full of sharp teeth, and a row of bony knobs runs down its spine. Crouching. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.negative_extra: hair, fur, goat, ghost, skeleton, bare bones, bird, chicken
visual.note: Ben, round 3: "chicken legs" means reverse-jointed legs, not bird legs; fleshed, skinny and starved, not a skeleton.

visual.text: A tiny old man, a little house spirit about knee-high to a grown person, standing on the floorboards beside the base of a large stove, which shows how small he is. He is wholly human in shape, a little old man and not an animal. He wears simple peasant clothes. A huge beard and moustache cover his mouth and most of his face, and only his tousled hair pokes out above. He has large human ears and gnarled hands with sharp, claw-like fingernails, and looks like an unsettling little gremlin. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.note: Ben, round 3: seed 21 good but no cat in the picture and nothing cat-like in him; keep the scary hands and claws.
visual.negative_extra: cat, kitten, animal, fur, whiskers, cat ears

visual.text: A thin, gaunt young woman, a malevolent spirit of the lake, standing at the water's edge as if she has just risen from a swamp. Her very long, wet, straggling dark hair falls in heavy strands over her shoulders and down her chest, covering her breasts completely, tangled and entwined with leaves, weeds and swamp vegetation. Wet water plants and leaves cling around her hips like a short wrap, leaving her thighs and legs bare. A water lily blossom is tucked behind one ear. Her face is lean and angular, not a classical beauty, with a cold, luring expression. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.negative_extra: nudity, nipples, classical drapery, shawl, trousers
visual.note: Ben, round 3: seed 21 good with the lily; hair longer and covering her breasts, entwined with vegetation; show more thigh, no plant trousers.

visual.text: An aristocratic vampire nobleman, tall and gaunt, in an elegant high-collared nineteenth-century frock coat and cravat, his long hair swept back. At first glance he looks refined; on a closer look his skin is deathly pale, his long, thin fingers end in long pointed fingernails, and his lips are closed, with at most the faintest hint of a slightly long canine tooth. His eyes are cold and predatory. Half-length portrait.
visual.negative_extra: coffin, grave, corpse, cape, blood, red, open mouth, prominent fangs
visual.note: Ben, round 3: good, but no blood and no red; fangs much less obvious.

visual.text: A gross, fat old man of the swamp who is part frog: a man first and a frog second. His face is a man's face with frog-like features: a very wide, thin-lipped mouth, bulging heavy-lidded eyes and a broad, flat human nose. Thin, wispy, stringy, greasy hair straggles from his warty head, and a thin, wispy, stringy beard hangs from his chin in loose strands with bits of weed. His skin is fat, lumpy, slimy and warty, with a sagging belly. His hands and feet are heavily webbed, with wide sheets of skin between the long fingers and toes, which end in claws. He squats at the edge of a swamp. Full-length figure: the whole body from the top of the head down to the feet is inside the frame, with empty paper around it.
visual.negative_extra: hat, cap, toad, animal snout, thick moss beard
visual.note: Ben, round 3: a man who is part frog, not a frog who is part man; human nose, wispy stringy beard and head hair, more webbing.
